name: r1
prompt: Design the pedal steel guitar plugin UI for Northern Valley Audio. Goal: the best real product UI, premium quality, calm and uncluttered, readable from across a room. Image 1 = the frame and cream colour scheme to follow (top bar and bottom deck). Image 2 = the calm cream stage look behind the instrument. Image 3 = the instrument's TRUE proportions and three-quarter 3D perspective (long and slim, legs, pedal rack, knee levers, contact shadow; keyhead LEFT, changer RIGHT). Layout: TOP BAR: 'Pedal Steel' script wordmark with three orange stripes and NORTHERN VALLEY AUDIO; amber dot-matrix LED preset display '01 SWEET GEORGIA E9' with arrows, BROWSE, SAVE; OUTPUT meter and TRIM on the right. MIDDLE: only the walnut pedal steel on a calm cream stage, three-quarter view, about 70% of the window width, generous empty space around it. BOTTOM DECK: one clean row: six knobs TONE 65 %, PICK 40 % | GLIDE 145 ms, SWELL 35 % | ECHO 18 %, REVERB 28 % under small group headers VOICE / FEEL / SPACE, values clearly below; then a compact pedal cluster A B C (pedals) and LKL LKR (knee levers) with A and B engaged; then VOLUME PEDAL as a horizontal slider at 72%; MODE Smart Auto-Pedal E9 and MIDI LEARN small and tidy. Matte cream surfaces, walnut only as trim, burnt-orange accents, dark brown print, no mirror-chrome or glossy panels, generous spacing, nothing cramped, no decorative clutter. 1600x1000, ultra-realistic. Knobs: black knurled machined knobs with a white pointer and fine tick scales. Pedal cluster: miniature satin foot pedals and small knee-lever paddles, amber LED above each. Generate 2 images.
